id.description: Unique service identifier in the format SVC-XXX

name.description: Human-readable name of the technical service

description.description: Concise description of the service's purpose and responsibilities

classification.description: domain_specific: serves one business domain; cross_cutting: spans multiple capabilities; foundation: infrastructure/platform with no business logic

capability_mappings.description: Array of capability or sub-capability IDs this service supports (e.g. CAP-001 or CAP-001.04)

dependencies.description: Array of SVC IDs this service depends on at runtime

technology_constraints.description: Regulatory, performance, or architectural constraints that shape technology choices

design_decisions.description: Architectural design decisions recorded for this service
